title: Scam. Doesn’t respect buyers’ rights
body: I want to share my experience with Habits. I grew fond of this app. Nice interface, useful, etc. I thought it was worth buying the lifetime premium for the backup, widget and dark theme. So I did. However this 2021, the app updated itself and it will not respect the fact that I had already bought the premium version. Restore previous purchase is buggy and will not work. Moreover, I tried to contact the app support with no success. I am very disappointed. The new premium version is not only expensive but also very buggy. I demand habits to contact me asap to either give me a full refund or respect that I had a premium version before they decided to go with monthly suscriptions.

title: Chart and percentages fixed and limited and not aligned with users’s goals
body:
The chart and the percentages do not reflect the acomplishment of your tasks.

I think monthly percentage should be calculated based on your personal goals if not that gives one the feeling of truly never achieving your personal goal.
 
For example there are task that you don’t perform every day so you will never achieve 100% because it is fixed to a 90 day streak. 

for example for those tasks that I can’t perform every day it would be impossible to reach 100%. 

I mean, we all have schedules and in real life we have work, school and multiple tasks, family, etc... that makes it difficult to do a task every day and that’s why we schedule tasks to perform in specific periods of time and the percentages should be calculated based on your personal goals. 

So for example if you set your personal goal (Study German) to 2 times a week then your 100% accomplishment would be 8 times in a month because that is what you set as your personal goal on the other hand if it is calculated on 90 days streak you will never achieve your personal goals and the percentage will never be align with your personal goal.

The app is also lacking the ability to specify the days you want to perform the task for example:

Workout 
Monday, Friday and Saturday.

Read 
Saturday and Sunday
